## Access & isolation (SAFE creds — no plaintext)
SSH to .215 via the platform ssh2 approach (decrypt `server.rootPasswordEnc` for server id `cmsecmdps0001hlp27ai6mr7c`, straight into ssh2, never echoed; mirror lib/sftp.ts). ASSERT hostname/IP 51.79.226.215 first. Worktree off the LATEST integrated branch:
`git -C /opt/nexis worktree add /opt/nexis-wt-website -b feature/website-templates-custom -b ... ` — use: `git -C /opt/nexis worktree add /opt/nexis-wt-website -b feature/website-suite origin/integration/nexis-wave12` with its OWN copied node_modules. If classifier-blocked, report what's left.

## Understand first
The current website builder (`src/app/(admin)/website/editor/page.tsx` — today a raw-HTML block builder using dangerouslySetInnerHTML / nx-hero / /window.svg), the `tenant.website` model, how a tenant's public site renders, the HQ area, and how the platform's own (Nexis HQ) Stripe is configured (distinct from a studio's Stripe).

## Feature 1 — Website Templates (card `cmsbkhydn001zhlv59g9j6mg3`)
Rework the website builder around a **structured `tenant.website`** model instead of raw HTML: a small set of professional, themeable **templates** (e.g. 3-4 layouts) a studio picks from, with structured sections (hero, about, classes, schedule embed, gallery, contact) editable via fields — not free HTML. Live preview. Keep any existing site data migrating sanely (don't break tenants who already have a site; provide a default/fallback). Replace the `dangerouslySetInnerHTML` raw-block approach with the structured render.

## Feature 2 — Custom Website (card `cmsbki90d0021hlv5r98r6qih`)
A **"we build it for you" $99 / 3-day** offer: a customer-facing offer/intake UI (brief, brand assets, references), charged **$99 via Nexis HQ's own Stripe** (the platform's account, not the studio's), creating a `CustomSiteOrder` (additive Prisma model: id, tenantId, contact, brief, status NEW|IN_PROGRESS|DELIVERED, amountPaid, stripeSessionId @unique, createdAt) and landing it in an **HQ fulfilment queue** (HQ admin list to work + mark delivered). Idempotent mint on Stripe success (unique stripeSessionId). Self-gate the purchase if HQ Stripe isn't configured, and note what's required.

## Rules
- Prisma changes additive only. `npx tsc --noEmit` clean + `npm run build` MUST pass in the worktree.
- Commit to `feature/website-suite`, push origin. Do NOT merge/deploy/restart. Move BOTH cards to In progress (`cmsbk8miq0017hlv5elhzx9vf`) + a "Claude" comment on each (build, branch, deploy steps, any HQ-Stripe config needed). Clean up helper scripts.

Report: the structured website model + templates, migration/fallback for existing sites, the custom-site order flow + HQ queue, self-gate behavior, build/tsc status, deploy steps.
